# Objective

Apply the user-confirmed disposition of external review round 3 (2026-10-22):
four engineering fixes plus one documentation fix. Point 1 (remove the Phred
heuristic) was rejected again; only its README workaround wording changes.
Report: `20261022-*_review3-fixes.report.qmd`.

# Scope (confirmed items)

1. **P2 — StagedWriter cross-call buffering.** `write_rows` flushed per call,
   so the streaming pipeline produced one Parquet row group per pair and per
   finding (measured: 2000 row groups / 3.68 MB vs 1 group / 3.6 KB for 2000
   rows). Fix: bounded buffer across calls, flush at `WRITE_BATCH_ROWS`,
   flush remainder on close. Regression test on row-group count and size.
2. **P2 — findings emitted as produced.** `tech_findings` accumulated one
   group's findings (O(pairs × metrics)). Fix: pipeline emits each finding as
   `TechnicalAssessment.feed` returns it, retains only statuses, a unique
   reason-code list, component findings, and the bounded HTML preview;
   `finalize_group_decision` takes `tech_reason_codes` instead of a findings
   list; `evaluate_group` derives codes for its callers.
3. **P2 — runtime BLAS/OpenMP limits.** `_worker_init`'s env `setdefault`
   runs after NumPy import and caps nothing (measured: 12 threads before and
   after). Fix: `threadpoolctl` runtime limits in workers and around the
   main-process comparison stage (`main_threads` from `ResourceConfig`);
   regression test introspects actual pool limits; README resource bullet
   corrected.
4. **P2 — reasons for INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.** INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVATIONS and
   MISSING_EVIDENCE rows worsened status without a finding, so decisions
   carried no blocking reason (reproduced: MISSING_EVIDENCE, zero findings).
   Fix: `feed` emits a finding per such row (reason code, datasets, observed
   counts, required minimum); codes propagate into the decision.
5. **README wording (point 1 concession).** Remove the "re-encode your
   qualities" workaround; the resolution is verifying the file's true
   encoding or reporting the case upstream — the tool never advises altering
   the data under assessment.

# Files to touch

`src/seqconsistency/{parquet_io,policy,pipeline}.py`, `pyproject.toml`,
`pixi.toml`/lock (threadpoolctl), `tests/**`, `README.md`,
`benchmarks/results-2026-10-21.*` (re-measured), `docs/**`.

# Verification (results)

Executed 2026-10-22; report: `20261022-113634_review3-fixes.report.qmd`.

1. All regression tests added (row groups; batch-boundary flush; abort logging; streamed findings 793/793; pool limits introspected and GC-stable; insufficient-evidence findings with counts).
2. Full suite 188 passed (incl. slow); mypy strict and ruff clean.
3. First benchmark run DISCARDED (contention signature: uniform slowdown on untouched paths, gate fired at load1 3.99); clean re-run under a tightened gate (load1<2/load5<3, started 1.72) committed as `results-2026-10-22.{json,md}`: FASTQ +1.3..+3.3% (noise), pair scaling +3.6..+6.8% (noise), BAM 59.2k rec/s (within its ±8% same-code band), memory flat.
4. Examples unchanged.
